associates.clause: Specified Persons must make their Associates aware of the requirements of this Policy and take reasonable steps to ensure their Associates comply with those requirements.
associates.reasoning: Associate is defined broadly to include a spouse or partner, dependent children, a resident relative and companies, trusts or partnerships the Specified Person controls or influences, and the Policy's margin lending, hedging and Trading Window rules bind Specified Persons and their Associates together.

tiers.tier_name: Employees, contractors, secondees and directors of CBA and its subsidiaries who are not Specified Persons

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: This Policy applies to all full-time, part-time and casual employees, contractors, secondees, and directors of CBA and its subsidiaries.
findings.definition: any derivatives products relating to the types of securities listed above, including but not limited to equity swaps, warrants, futures, contracts for difference, hedges and exchange traded or over the counter options, whether settled by cash or otherwise.
findings.reasoning: A cash-settled hedge is itself a Security because Security is defined to include hedges and cash-settled derivatives, so buying it is Trading, but the hedging restrictions in paragraphs 8 and 9 are additional requirements limited to Specified Persons, and to CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries and Group Executives specifically, leaving other employees, contractors and directors free to Trade it without approval or notice.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: This Policy applies to all full-time, part-time and casual employees, contractors, secondees, and directors of CBA and its subsidiaries.
findings.definition: buying, selling, acquiring, transferring or disposing of Securities, agreeing to do so, or procuring someone else to do so, whether on or off market.
findings.section: Purpose and scope; Definitions – Trade or Trading
findings.reasoning: A physically settled hedge ends in a disposal of the shares, expressly caught as 'disposing of Securities' under the Trade definition, but the hedging restrictions in paragraphs 8 and 9 are additional requirements limited to Specified Persons and the named Board/Company Secretary/Group Executive group, so other employees, contractors and directors need no approval or notice.

findings.question: encumber
findings.reasoning: The ban on using Group Securities as security for financing arrangements is an additional requirement for Specified Persons only, so it does not reach general employees, contractors or directors.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.reasoning: The margin lending prohibition is one of the additional requirements that applies only to Specified Persons and their Associates, not to the general workforce.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.reasoning: No provision addresses secured financing against a derivative for any tier, and in any event the additional Specified Person requirements do not apply to general employees, contractors or directors.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.reasoning: The stock lending prohibition in the additional Specified Person requirements does not extend to general employees, contractors or directors.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.reasoning: The statement that a forced sale may breach the Policy appears only in the additional requirements for Specified Persons, which do not bind general employees, contractors or directors.

tiers.tier_name: CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries and Group Executives (and their Associates)

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: In addition, the CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries, Group Executives, and each of their Associates, must not enter into a transaction that limits the economic risk of their exposure to any vested Group Securities.
findings.reasoning: Unlike the narrower unvested/holding-lock hedging ban in paragraph 8 that applies to all Specified Persons, paragraph 9 expressly extends the ban on transactions that limit economic risk to any vested Group Securities for CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries and Group Executives, which catches a cash-settled hedge.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: In addition, the CBA Board directors, Group Company Secretaries, Group Executives, and each of their Associates, must not enter into a transaction that limits the economic risk of their exposure to any vested Group Securities.
findings.reasoning: The same express ban on limiting economic risk on any vested Group Securities catches a physically settled hedge, which additionally ends in a disposal of the shares.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy;
findings.reasoning: Using Group Securities as security for margin lending or any other secured financing arrangement is expressly prohibited, which is precisely what encumbering the shares in favour of a lender does.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy;
findings.reasoning: Margin lending secured against Group Securities is expressly named and banned outright, with no carve-out for vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.reasoning: The 16.a ban is worded as using Group Securities themselves as security for financing, not securities generally, so it does not on its terms reach a loan secured on a derivative over the shares rather than the shares themselves, and no other provision addresses it.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: enter into contracts for difference or use any instruments or enter any arrangements for short selling or stock lending of Group Securities, except to the extent covered by any of the “Exceptions to Trading Windows” in this Policy.
findings.reasoning: Entering any arrangement for stock lending of Group Securities is expressly prohibited unless it falls within a listed Trading Window exception, none of which covers an ordinary title-transfer securities loan.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: use Group Securities as security for margin lending or other secured financing arrangements, as a forced sale may lead to the breach of this Policy;
findings.reasoning: The Policy states expressly that a forced sale by a lender following a secured financing arrangement may itself lead to a breach of the Policy, making enforcement in a closed period a breach by the employee rather than a permitted or clearable event.
